== Notes ==
* This skill can be used to effectively replace [[fiery]] [[bowstring]], and synergizes with [[Conjure Flame]] and/or [[Mark of Rodgort]].
* The additional fire damage from this skill is affected by [[armor rating]] and dealt separately from the arrow damage.
